```{r conditional-values}
epus <- dplyr::case_when(
  params$draft ~ "[Mid-Atlantic Bight, MAB] *or* [Gulf of Maine (GOM) and Georges Bank (GB)]",
  params$region == "MidAtlantic" ~ "Mid-Atlantic Bight, MAB",
  params$region == "NewEngland" ~ "Gulf of Maine (GOM) and Georges Bank (GB)"
)

region <- dplyr::case_when(
  params$draft ~ "[the Mid-Atlantic Bight] *or* [New England]",
  params$region == "MidAtlantic" ~ "the Mid-Atlantic Bight",
  params$region == "NewEngland" ~ "New England"
)

region2 <- dplyr::case_when(
  params$draft ~ "[Mid-Atlantic] *or* [New England]",
  params$region == "MidAtlantic" ~ "Mid-Atlantic",
  params$region == "NewEngland" ~ "New England"
)

caption_key <- read.csv(params$fig_caption) 
```

## State of the Ecosystem (SOE) reporting
### Improving ecosystem information and synthesis for fishery managers
:::: {.soe-60-40-slide}

::: {.soe-60-column}
- Ecosystem indicators linked to management objectives `r Cite(myBib, "depiper_operationalizing_2017")`
    + Contextual information
    + Report evolving since 2016
    + Fishery-relevant subset of full Ecosystem Status Reports

- Open science emphasis `r Cite(myBib, "bastille_improving_2020")`

- Used within Mid-Atlantic Fishery Management Council's Ecosystem Process `r Cite(myBib, "muffley_there_2020")`
:::

::: {.soe-40-column}
```{r, fig.alt = "IEA process from goal setting to assessment to strategy evaluation with feedbacks"}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("images/iea-loop.png"))
```
*The IEA Loop[^1]*

[^1]: https://www.integratedecosystemassessment.noaa.gov/national/IEA-approach
:::

1. 2024 Highlights
